items.title: Chamberlain University to Open Cincinnati Campus, Accepting Applications for Fall 2026
items.summary: Covista, Nation's Largest Healthcare Educator, Opening Cincinnati Campus to Help Address Region's Nearly 50,000 Open Healthcare Jobs Chamberlain University, the nation's largest school of nursing and a Covista institution, today announced it will open a new campus in Cincinnati, Ohio. The Cincinnati campus will be Chamberlain's 25th campus and is one of several new campuses opening in the next year as part of the institution's national expansion strategy. The university is now accepting applications for fall 2026, with pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) classes beginning August 31, 2026. The announcement comes as Ohio works to meet a significant healthcare workforce demand with the state recording nearly 50,000 healthcare vacancies per month last year.
